name: Selenella
note: Selenella is the brand of Consorzio Patata Italiana di Qualità Soc. Cons. R.L. (Villanova di Castenaso, Bologna), a consortium of potato producers, cooperatives and private traders; 10 member companies representing about 320 producers. Ownership claim from the consortium's own site; members are private producers, cooperatives and traders — no state or fund in the chain.
